title: UltrafastEngine run spec (run.json)
description: The pulse, instruments and numerical settings of a run (docs/reference/run-spec.md). SI units.

version.description: Format version (older versions are migrated on load).

name.description: Name of the run

probes.description: Snapshots of the pulse: "all", "end" or a list of element ids Default: "end".

instruments.description: Instruments: what you measure, and where (docs/reference/instruments.md).

detectors.description: Detector presets by name: {instrument: {keys for an instrument that does not set them}, detector: {read-out}}; an instrument says "detector": "name" (docs/reference/instruments.md#detector-presets)

inputBeam.description: Default beam for nonlinear elements without one A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, sampled).

coherence.description: Partially coherent beam: a run over coherent modes (docs/reference/transverse.md#partial-coherence)

fit.description: Fit transform parameters (and any listed number) to every instrument with measured data (fitting plugin).

backward.description: Backward propagation: the pulse is the field measured downstream; find the field at every plane upstream (fitting plugin).

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema (editor support).

shape.description: Pulse shape; cw: one spectral bin at centerWavelengthM, with powerW Default: gaussian.

centerWavelengthM.description: Carrier wavelength (for spectrum: default = intensity-weighted mean) [m]

powerW.description: Power of a cw source (shape cw) [W]

chirp.description: Spectral phase about the carrier: gddS2/todS3/fodS4 or gddFs2/todFs3/fodFs4

polarization.description: "x", "y", "45", "-45", "rcp", "lcp", {angleDeg, ellipticity} or [exRe, exIm, eyRe, eyIm] Default: "x".

spectrum.description: Measured spectrum (shape: spectrum): wavelengthsM + intensity (+ phaseRad), or csv

pedestal.description: Pedestal / contrast components: one object or a list (replica, prePulse, postPulse, ase, phaseNoise, exponential)

noise.description: Quantum noise on the input: one photon per frequency mode with random phase (supercontinuum coherence, parametric seeding)

obj.chirp.description: Spectral phase coefficients about the carrier.

csv.description: CSV file: wavelength, intensity, optional phase

wavelengthUnit.description: Unit of the CSV wavelength column Default: nm.

resolutionM.description: Resolution (Gaussian FWHM) of the spectrometer that recorded it [m] Default: 0 (unknown).

deconvolve.description: Remove the recording resolution (Richardson-Lucy) before use Default: false.

extrapolate.description: Outside the measured wavelengths: no light, or Gaussian tails fitted to the data Default: zero.

background.description: Background to subtract: a number (intensity units), "auto" (median of the darker edge, robust to a spectrum cut off on one side), "min" or "none" Default: none.

threshold.description: After background subtraction, values below this fraction of the peak are set to zero Default: 0.

obj.pulseNoise.description: Quantum noise added to the input pulse (docs/reference/fibers.md#noise-and-coherence).

seed.description: Random seed (a coherence study varies it) Default: 1.

polarization.description: Noise in the pulse's polarisation only, or one photon in each of x and y Default: same.

auto.description: Size the grid from pulse and system Default: true.

n.description: Number of samples (with auto: a minimum) Default: 4096.

windowS.description: Time window [s] Default: 30 x the transform limit.

snapCarrier.description: Put the carrier on the frequency grid Default: true.

minSpanFraction.description: Nonlinear runs: minimum half-span / carrier Default: 0.1.

minPointsPerFwhm.description: Samples across the transform-limited FWHM Default: 12.

satelliteLevel.description: Weakest combination of ghost / replica satellites the window makes room for (relative intensity); weaker multi-satellite combinations may wrap around the window Default: 1e-8.

extendForSatellites.description: Manual window (auto false): grow the window, keeping dt, so that ghosts, echoes and pedestal replicas above satelliteLevel fit Default: false.

strict.description: A ghost, echo or pedestal that wraps around the window is an error instead of a warning Default: false.

tail.description: Delayed-light ledger: true, or {windowS, warnEnergyFraction, exactSteps (every linear element takes the exact long-grid step; default false), crossPhase (first-order cross-phase of the tail by the main pulse in nonlinear elements; default true)}. A second, long, linear grid with the same time step carries ghosts, echoes and gas-line tails next to the main nonlinear grid (docs/reference/delayed-light.md) Default: false.

nonlinear.description: Master switch for nonlinear propagation Default: true.

raman.description: Delayed (Raman) response of materials that have one Default: true.

fieldMode.description: Envelope or carrier-resolved (real field) propagation Default: auto.

fieldHarmonic.description: Highest harmonic the carrier-resolved grid holds Default: 3.

absoluteIndex.description: Add air dispersion to air paths quoted relative to air Default: true.

polarization.description: Jones (two polarisations) or scalar Default: jones.

losses.description: false removes flat loss terms Default: true.

beamTracking.description: Gaussian beam (q) tracking: "auto" (on with a Gaussian inputBeam), "on", "off" Default: "auto".

spatioTemporal.description: Spatio-temporal couplings (angular / spatial dispersion, pulse-front tilt) with the tracked beam: "auto" (tracked, and their group-delay dispersion applied unless an element has traced groupDelayS), "on", "track" (reported only), "profile" (gratings and tilted surfaces tilt each frequency of a carried cartesian profile; the field holds the coupling), "off" (docs/reference/components.md#spatio-temporal-couplings) Default: "auto".

transverse.description: Default spatial model for every bulk/gap/crystal without one

ionization.description: Photo-ionisation and plasma in every nonlinear bulk element: true or an ionization object Default: false.

points.description: Radial samples (cartesian: nx = ny if omitted) Default: 64.

radiusM.description: Radial grid extent [m] Default: extentFactor x expected radius.

extentFactor.description: Grid extent / expected beam radius Default: 3.5.

paraxial.description: Paraxial diffraction operator instead of the exact one Default: false.

transport.description: How a profile from before is brought in Default: auto.

initialProfile.description: The field at the first spatial element

polarization.description: Jones (vector) fields on the grid: auto = when the beam carries a y component Default: auto.

equation.description: Nonlinear coupling: paraxial envelope, or UPPE (n omega / c k_z per plane wave) Default: envelope.

spectralSamples.description: Frequencies at which the transverse profile is stored and (linear elements) propagated; fewer is faster for narrowband pulses Default: 48.

absorbingBoundary.description: Linear elements: absorb light leaving the grid instead of reflecting / wrapping it -- true (outer 15 %) or {widthFraction}; the absorbed energy is booked as 'grid boundary' (docs/reference/transverse.md#diffraction-and-apertures) Default: false.

kind.description: Shape: Gaussian, super-Gaussian (order), flatTop (super-Gaussian of order 10), tophat (hard edge, uniform), Hermite-Gauss (modeX, modeY), Laguerre-Gauss (modeP, modeL), Bessel-Gauss (coneAngleRad), Airy (radiusM = scale, truncation), measured (file) Default: gaussian.

modeL.description: laguerreGauss: azimuthal index l (helical phase, cartesian grids) Default: 0.

coneAngleRad.description: besselGauss: cone angle of the plane waves, k_r = k sin(angle) [rad]

truncation.description: airy: the exponential truncation a in Ai(x / x0) exp(a x / x0) Default: 0.1.

file.description: measured: NPZ with x_m, y_m (or r_m), fluence or amplitude, and optionally phase_rad; relative to the file that names it

background.description: measured: a number subtracted from the fluence, or "auto" (the median of the map's edge)

pixelSizeM.description: measured: pixel size of a PNG image [m]

threshold.description: measured: fluence below this fraction of the peak is set to zero Default: 0.

center.description: measured: move the fluence centroid to the axis Default: false.

geometry.description: round: a function of r (elliptical with radiusXM != radiusYM); square: separable in x and y (rectangular, cartesian grids) Default: round.

radiusM.description: 1/e^2 radius; tophat: edge radius or half-width (default: from the element's beam) [m]

ripple.description: Seed ripple (cartesian): {periodM, relativeAmplitude, angleDeg, phaseRad}: amplitude x (1 + a cos(2 pi (x cos t + y sin t) / period + phase)). The Bespalov-Talanov seed (docs/reference/transverse.md#small-scale-self-focusing)

noise.description: Seeded random noise (cartesian): {relativeAmplitudeRms, phaseRmsRad, correlationLengthM, seed, components}

method.description: Adaptive ERK4(3)-IP or fixed-step RK4IP Default: adaptive.

tolerance.description: Adaptive: local relative error per step Default: 1e-6.

maxPhasePerStepRad.description: Fixed: max nonlinear phase per step; adaptive: initial step [rad] Default: 0.01.

maxAreaChangePerStep.description: Limit on |d ln A_eff| per step (focusing beams) Default: 0.05.

target.description: material:NAME, element:ID (trailing * wildcard), element:*, type:TYPE or global

property.description: Property to change (lengthM, n2, index, beam, coating, timeResponse, filter, enabled, ...)

value.description: New value (numbers may carry a unit string: "2.2E-20 m^2/W")

model.description: New model (an object with kind, an expression, or "@callback")

mode.description: replace, or add (time responses and filters) Default: replace.

obj.outputs.description: Files written by the CLI / WriteAll.

maxPoints.description: Cap exported traces (0 = full grid incl. complex fields) Default: 0.

backend.description: Back-end: cpu, auto (the fastest available that supports each element), or one a plugin registers (cuda, opencl) Default: cpu.

fft.description: CPU FFT provider (process-wide): auto = Accelerate on macOS, FFTW when installed, else managed Default: ULTRAFAST_FFT or auto.

device.description: GPU device index (ultrafast devices lists them) Default: -1 (first suitable).

gpuMinPoints.description: backend auto: smallest problem (complex samples) sent to a GPU; smaller ones stay on the CPU Default: 8192 (1-D), 32768 (spatial); 0 for an explicit GPU back-end.

deviceSlots.description: GPU back-ends: element propagations running on one device at the same time (parallel studies, fits); when all are busy, auto runs the element on the CPU and an explicit back-end waits Default: 4.

obj.coherence.description: A Gaussian-Schell beam as an incoherent sum of Hermite-Gauss modes (docs/reference/transverse.md#partial-coherence).

dimensions.description: 1 (x only) or 2 Default: 2; 1 for a grid with ny = 1.

element.description: Element whose transverse.initialProfile the modes replace Default: the first with a transverse object.

parameters.description: Numbers to fit by path (in addition to the transform parameters marked for fitting)

estimator.description: Fitting algorithm (plugins may register more) Default: levenbergMarquardt.

tolerance.description: Relative chi^2 change (LM) / cost spread (CMA-ES) that ends the fit Default: 1e-4 (LM), 1e-6 (CMA-ES).

freezeGrid.description: Fix the time/frequency grid (2x the planned bandwidth) for all evaluations Default: true.

parallel.description: Simulations run at the same time (Jacobian columns, CMA-ES population, MCMC walkers) Default: 1.

sigma0.description: CMA-ES initial step (in units of each parameter's scale) Default: 0.3.

polish.description: CMA-ES: finish with Levenberg-Marquardt Default: true.

start.description: MCMC start: a Levenberg-Marquardt optimum or the initial values Default: optimum.

spread.description: MCMC starting ball (in units of each scale) Default: 0.1.

path.description: pulse/..., element:ID/..., instrument:NAME/..., material:NAME/prop, run/..., system/...

name.description: Label Default: the path.

initial.description: Start value Default: the value in the files.

prior.description: Gaussian prior: sigma (mean = initial) or {mean, sigma}

from.description: Plane where the run's pulse was measured: an element id (after it) or "end" Default: "end".

to.description: Plane to propagate back to: an element id (after it) or "input" Default: "input".

regularization.description: Relative Tikhonov level for inverting linear terms (transmission below this x the peak is not recovered) Default: 1e-3.

active.description: Amplifiers, crystals and spatial elements: refuse, undo as the filter they were in a forward reference run, or pass through Default: error.

referencePulse.description: active = linearized: the input pulse of the forward reference run

obj.sampling.description: Near / far field and apertures for non-imaging instruments. (docs/reference/instruments.md#sampling)

plane.description: Near field, or the focal plane of a lens Default: near.

propagateM.description: Near field: free-space propagation before the aperture [m] Default: 0.

obj.instrumentAxis.description: Sampling of a curve instrument's axis (spectrometer wavelengths, scope times, autocorrelator / cross-correlator delays, polarimeter wavelengths, delay scan, contrast, beam profile, phase-matching curve). Units: those of the axis (m, s). (docs/reference/instruments.md#axis-where-readings-are-taken)

values.description: Explicit reading positions (e.g. the pixel wavelengths of your spectrometer) [SI]

from.description: First reading [SI] Default: the start of the simulated axis.

to.description: Last reading [SI] Default: the end of the simulated axis.

points.description: Number of readings (with from / to, when no step) Default: as simulated.

binWidth.description: Width each reading integrates over: a number, or "pixel" (the spacing between readings) [SI] Default: 0 (point readings).

resolution.description: Gaussian blur (FWHM) applied before binning [SI] Default: 0.

obj.measured.description: Recorded data for one instrument, compared with its simulated reading on the measured axis (only where the simulated instrument has readings), after matching the recording's resolution. (docs/reference/measured-data.md)

file.description: CSV, NPZ or JSON file, relative to the run file

columns.description: Column / array names: x, y, sigma (curves); rows, cols, trace (traces)

normalize.description: How data and simulation are normalised before comparing Default: peak.

sigma.description: Uncertainty of each point relative to the data peak Default: 0.02.

background.description: A number to subtract, "auto" (median of the darker edge of the axis; for traces, the edges of the columns), "min" or "none" Default: none.

rangeX.description: Compare only this [min, max] of the measured axis [SI]

xUnit.description: Unit of the x column (overrides the name suffix)

yUnit.description: Unit of the y column ("dB" for logarithmic data)

valueSigma.description: Relative uncertainty of values given without one Default: 0.02.

valueWeight.description: Extra weight of the scalar residuals Default: 1.

weight.description: Weight of this instrument in a fit's chi^2 Default: 1.

simulated.description: Which arrays of the instrument to compare with: x, y | rows, cols, trace

scale.description: Compare in linear units, or in dB (high-dynamic-range data: contrast, cross-correlators) Default: linear.

sigmaDb.description: scale log: uncertainty of each point in dB [dB] Default: 1.

floorDb.description: scale log: floor relative to the peak (values below are clipped to it) [dB] Default: the data's minimum.

resolutionM.description: Resolution (Gaussian FWHM) of the recording spectrometer / profiler, in the unit of the axis [m]

resolutionS.description: Temporal / delay resolution (Gaussian FWHM) of the recording instrument [s]

matchResolution.description: Curves: when the recording is coarser than the simulated instrument, blur the simulated reading by the missing width before comparing Default: true.

resolutionS.description: Delay resolution of the scan (Gaussian FWHM, intensity AC) [s] Default: 0.

shgAcceptanceFwhmM.description: Phase-matching acceptance of the SHG crystal (FWHM of the SH wavelength window); 0: unlimited [m] Default: 0.

acceptancePoints.description: Grid of the finite-acceptance computation Default: 512.

maxN.description: Grid cap for the computation Default: 65536.

name.description: Name in the results (unique; repeated names get _2, _3) Default: kind_at.

at.description: "input", an element id (after that element) or "end" Default: "end".

sampling.description: What part of the beam the instrument sees: near / far field, pinhole, fibre, slit (non-imaging instruments)

beam.description: Beam model for 1-D locations (cameras, sampling): the instrument images this ideal Gaussian A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, sampled).

filter.description: Spectral transmission in front of the instrument (optics, detector spectral response): applied to the field before it is measured A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, superGaussian, table).

detector.description: Read-out of the recorded trace / readings: an object (calibration, noise, noise floor, bit depth, saturation, spectral response) or the name of a preset from the run spec's detectors, or {preset: name | file, ...overrides}

axis.description: Where a curve instrument takes its readings: explicit points or from / to / step, bin (pixel) width, Gaussian resolution

measured.description: Recorded data to compare this instrument with: a file name (CSV, NPZ, JSON), or an object (file, columns, normalize, sigma, background, rangeX, units, values, weight, resolutionM / resolutionS). docs/reference/measured-data.md

relay.description: Thin lenses {focalLengthM} and gaps {gapM}, in order

obj.relayStep.description: A relay step: a thin lens or a free-space gap.

qe.description: Quantum efficiency vs wavelength (a filter model: constant, table, gaussian, expression) A model: a number, a name / "@callback" / expression string, or an object with "kind" (callback, constant, expression, gaussian, superGaussian, table).

fullScaleJPerM2.description: Fluence at full scale [J/m^2] Default: 1.1 x peak.

noise.description: Fluctuating detector background (else a flat floor) Default: true.
